meaning: PASS means no release-blocking finding under this named profile, NOT global cleanliness.

content_identity.method: full git commit id + full git tree id + content manifest root
content_identity.manifest_root: sha256 over sorted records of "path\0mode\0sha256(file bytes | symlink target)"
content_identity.note: A digest over file NAMES alone does not bind content and must not be used.

supported_ci_surface.entrypoint: scripts/ci_core.sh (shared by local checkout, CI, external reproducers)
does_not_cover: full legacy test suite (22 known collection errors)

check_qualification.note: "Wired" means the check exists. "Qualified" means a fixture injecting the violation was proven to BLOCK. An earlier report said "17 classes"; the real count is 24 check() calls plus ~11 inline checks.
check_qualification.not_qualified_rationale: These three are non-blocking hygiene checks (stale scrub artifacts, one phantom name form, self-declared MIT). Every check that gates a hard blocker — secrets, PII, machine identity, private keys, licence, identity — is fixture-qualified.
